question: The periodic growth and drop in seawater level is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**tide.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tides** are the **periodic rise and fall **of sea water levels caused by the **gravitational pull **of the** moon and the sun.**
 
• The cycle of **high tides and low tides** occurs **twice a day,** with a period of about **12 hours** and **25 minutes.**
 
• Tides are important for** navigation, fishing**, and other** marine activities.**
 
• They also play a role in shaping **coastlines and ecosystems.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Waves** are the movement of energy through the water caused by **wind, earthquakes, or other disturbances.**

 
 
• They can be** large or small **and travel long distances.
 
 
 
• **Sea currents** are the **continuous flow of water** in the ocean caused by differences in **temperature, salinity, and wind patterns**.
 
 
• They can be surface currents or deep currents and have a significant impact on** climate and marine life.**
 
 
 
• A brief influx of water onto ordinarily dry terrain is known as **flooding**.
 
 
• **Rain, snow, storm surges, coastal storms, river overflows**, and **dam failure** can all cause flooding.
 
• Floods are **not** always safe.
